description: This file defines the 'DotListWizardMenu' class, which appears to generate HTML for a wizard menu interface with progress steps, used in a module related to Campaigns in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: DotListWizardMenu
classes.description: A class that generates HTML for a multi-step wizard menu interface with progress indicators.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wizard menu HTML based on provided steps and optionally shows links.

methods.name: getWizardMenuItemHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for each individual wizard menu item, optionally including a link.

methods.name: getWizardMenuHTML
methods.description: Wraps the generated menu items into a full HTML structure including external HTML template.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the generated HTML as a string representation of the object.
